description: UltraFit360 connects ChatGPT to your personal fitness and nutrition data. Ask what you ate this week, how your weight is trending, what workouts you logged, or for a full progress report — answers come straight from your UltraFit360 food diary, workout logs, body metrics, and AI coaching memory. With your confirmation, it can also log the meals you eat, adjust your daily calorie, macro, water and step targets, plan meals, swap exercises, and assign or build workout programs. Your identity comes solely from your authenticated session, so the app only ever accesses your own data. UltraFit360 is operated by Aptix Labs Private Limited; see https://ultrafit360.com/privacy-policy for how connector data is handled.

defaultPrompt: Give me a progress check-in: weight trend, workout consistency, and what to focus on next.
Design me a custom 4-day workout program based on my training history and goals.
How's my nutrition been this week — am I hitting my protein and calorie targets?
